recommendations.title: PUE 1.069 vs best-achieved 1.060
recommendations.action: Overhead is 13.9% above this facility's own best demonstrated performance (17.8 MWh in 30 days, about 216 MWh/yr if sustained). Compare current control settings with the best-performing period.

recommendations.title: Recurring cooling-overhead excursions (5 events in 30 days)
recommendations.action: Investigate cooling-plant behaviour during the flagged windows (2.5 MWh above expected). Check pump and fan control loops and any manual setpoint overrides.

recommendations.title: Overhead +14 kW on hot days (>= 25 C)
recommendations.action: Overhead averages 14 kW more above 25 C than at 5-15 C (742 hot hours in the last 120 days). Evaluate cooling-tower and pump scheduling for hot afternoons. Savings assume 25% of the uplift is recoverable (an assumption, not a measurement).
